claim_ceiling: Cycle 9 complete. 4 representations tested against adversarial benchmarks + temporal stability. ALL 4 FALSIFIED by language dominance > 0.9. Temporal stability excellent (drift < 0.01 for all). Key finding: product needs BOTH citation awareness AND explicit language debiasing. 12 benchmarks now established.
